app.name: Office Helpers
about.title: About Office Helpers
about.body:
Office Helpers v{version}

Brings back the classic Microsoft Office Assistants (Clippy, Merlin, Links, Rocky, Genius, F1) as floating desktop characters.

Code licensed under Apache 2.0. Characters are property of Microsoft and are included for preservation/nostalgia purposes only (see NOTICE).

Repository: https://github.com/erickson558/oldwindowshelpers
tips: Looks like you're writing a document. Need any help?
You can drag me anywhere on your desktop.
Remember to save your work often.
Did you know I can start with Windows? Turn it on from the menu.
If you like this app, buy me a beer from the menu ☕.
animate.Clippy: Abracadabra! A magic trick, paperclip included.
animate.Genius: Eureka! I just had a brilliant idea.
animate.Links: A bit of cat-style art for you.
animate.Merlin: May the magic be with you!
animate.Rocky: Off to dig for treasure in the trash!
animate.MotherNature: Mother Earth says: take a little better care of the planet.
animate.OfficeLogo: Spinning around like the old 90s Office logo.
animate.Dot: I can be whatever shape you want me to be!
animate.Scribble: An origami cat, folded with care.
animate.PowerPup: Off to save the day, cape and all!
animate.Will: To be, or not to be, that is the question.
animate.MonkeyKing: With my staff, nothing can stop me!
warning.autostart_blocked_body: Windows (or your antivirus, e.g. Kaspersky) blocked the registry change. This is a known false positive: unsigned PyInstaller .exe files sometimes get flagged just for registering themselves to start with Windows. You can add an exception for OldWindowsHelpers.exe in your antivirus, or report it as a false positive. See the README for details.
